capabilities: Add and switch between multiple habits
Cycle a day's state by clicking (done, missed, not tracked)
Display a full-year heatmap with month grids
Show streak, total done, missed, and success rate
Navigate between years and jump back to today
extras: Data is stored in a single data.json outside vault notes, so it works without creating any notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily habits visually; tracking habits normally requires creating and maintaining notes.
summary: Habit tracker that renders a heatmap-style calendar where you click days to mark habits done, missed, or untracked, with streak and success-rate stats.
